name: selvedge
description: Selvedge checks finished work against its brief and reports an evidenced PASS/FAIL per acceptance criterion. Target safety: a committed selvedge.json origin allowlist, the env commands with user-approved hooks, and a browser guard that refuses unlisted origins. Criteria to a frozen plan: criteria (extraction and a vague-criterion check), snapshot (an allowed page's accessibility tree) and plan (a planner, a static lint, and a sha256-frozen plan.json). Running it: run (no model call; --replay, a redacted --trace) and verdict (a verdict per criterion from the evidence alone).
